name: pi-gear
description: Pi coding-agent extension with macOS-sandboxed Bash, filesystem and network policy, task planning, subagents, and LSP tools.

scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test capabilities/*/*.test.ts commands/*.test.ts config/*.test.ts context/*/*.test.ts execution/*/*.test.ts execution/*/*/*.test.ts lifecycle/*.test.ts lsp/*.test.ts workspace/*.test.ts subagents/*/*.test.ts subagents/*/*/*.test.ts ui/*/*.test.ts ui/*/*/*.test.ts
scripts.test:sandbox:macos: node --experimental-strip-types --test execution/sandbox/integration.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-name-pattern='sandbox spawn abort and timeout' execution/sandbox/spawn.test.ts
